question.text: Under Section 13 of PMLA 2002, if the Director finds that a reporting entity has failed to comply with obligations under Chapter IV, the monetary penalty imposed on such entity for each failure shall be:

answer.text: Not less than Rs 5,000 but may extend to Rs 50,000
Not less than Rs 1 lakh but may extend to Rs 5 lakh
Not less than Rs 10,000 but may extend to Rs 1 lakh for each failure
Not less than Rs 25,000 but may extend to Rs 10 lakh

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 13 of PMLA 2002 empowers the Director, on finding a failure to comply with obligations under Chapter IV, to impose a monetary penalty on the reporting entity (or its designated director/employees) of not less than Rs 10,000 and which may extend to Rs 1 lakh for each failure. The Trap: Option B (Rs 1 lakh to Rs 5 lakh) is tempting because candidates may confuse the PMLA penalty band with the much larger SEBI Act penalties (for example, under Section 15HB, which can extend to crores). Options A and D are simply incorrect rupee bands. Note: Workbook references: NISM Series III-A p.162 for the PMLA Section 13 penalty band and p.191 for the contrast with SEBI Act penalties.
